WorkspaceEditorDescription.description: Choose a suitable name for the workspace. Additionally, a short description can also be saved.

WorkspaceEditorDocs.description: Share additional information about this workspace with your users here.

WorkspaceEditorSSOMappings.description: Select which SSO group has access to the workspace with which permission.
WorkspaceEditorSSOMappings.descriptionRoleUser: Can view workspace content (agents, transcribers, document repositories, etc.), but cannot edit it.
WorkspaceEditorSSOMappings.descriptionRoleEditor: Can view workspace content and additionally edit it.
WorkspaceEditorSSOMappings.descriptionRoleWorkspaceAdmin: Can manage the workspace and create, edit and delete agents, transcribers, document repositories, etc.

WorkspaceEditorAutoJoin.description: When “Automatic user” is enabled, everyone who can sign in to the box is automatically authorized as a user in this organization.

WorkspaceCreator.descriptionWorkspace: Choose a name and an optional description. You can configure further settings after creating the workspace.

WorkspaceList.descriptionEmpty: You do not have access to a workspace yet.
